At Bruern Abbey Senior School, we provide a diverse and comprehensive curriculum that rivals that of much larger schools. Our carefully designed academic program ensures that boys develop a strong foundation in key subjects while also exploring a broad range of disciplines that foster curiosity and critical thinking.
In their first year at Bruern Abbey (Third Form), pupils study the following subjects:
Towards the end of the Third Form, pupils and their parents, in consultation with the School, will make choices about optional subjects to study for GCSE or equivalent qualifications.
Core Subjects
English Language
English Literature
Mathematics
Optional Subjects
Further information for current parents can be found within the senior parents’ portal.
Business Studies
Enterprise and Marketing
Art
Three-Dimensional Design
Information Technology
Geography
Sports Studies or Physical Education
Leith’s Certificate in Culinary Skills
Modern Foreign Languages (taught online)
Schedule a Visit
To learn more about our school and how we can help your child succeed, we encourage you to enquire and schedule a visit. Witness firsthand our commitment to providing an exceptional educational experience for students with learning differences. Alternatively, read our Bruern Specialisms.
Learn more about the unique expertise we offer at Bruern Abbey here.
English Language
English Literature
Mathematics
Business Studies
Geography
Art
Computing

There are twice as many English and Maths lessons as a standard prep school would for all our juniors, coupled with having two teachers in each class for these key subjects. Historically, it is so often these core skills that have hindered pupils from both comprehending the work being studied and showing their potential.
On top of the core English and Maths, pupils are taught the following subjects to give breadth and variety to their curriculum.
The curriculum is balanced and broadly based, and strongly promotes the spiritual, moral, social, cultural, mental and physical development of our pupils. It prepares our pupils well for the opportunities, responsibilities and experiences of life in British Society, including the provision for their economic well-being. It enables pupils to acquire skills in speaking, reading, writing, listening and numeracy.
The admissions process for Bruern Abbey Prep and Senior School is carefully structured to reflect our small size and specialist focus. While it is detailed, it can be outlined in the five key stages here.
Geography
Religious Studies
Music
Design and Technology
Art

Welcome to Bruern Abbey Senior School
At Bruern Senior, we know that pupils do their best when they are understood as individuals and are encouraged to be themselves. We champion difference, recognising that no two pupils learn, think or develop in the same way, and our size means we can take a truly individual approach.
As any teenager will tell you, the GCSE years can be demanding but the right approach can be transformative. Having opened in 2022, Bruern pupils achieved an outstanding first set of GCSE results in 2025, earning boys places at a range of excellent sixth form options. But we are not standing still: having completed a recent development and expansion of our site and increased the range of academic and professional options open to pupils. Bruern Senior offers the very best of an independent education: high expectations, excellent teaching and a broad, engaging curriculum, combined with the flexibility and insight to support pupils to chase high aspirations. Small class sizes and expert staff allow us to adapt our teaching carefully, ensuring that each pupil is supported, challenged and inspired.
At Bruern, there is no single model of success. Instead, pupils are encouraged to pursue their own ideas, interests and identities within a supportive and purposeful community. We place great emphasis on developing confidence and pursuing individual interests, helping each to recognise their strengths, take intellectual risks, and believe in their ability to succeed.
We are also excited to be opening the Senior School to girls from 2027, an important development that reflects our ambition and our confidence in the Bruern approach.
I hope this introduction gives you a sense of what makes Bruern Abbey Senior School such a distinctive and nurturing place. We would be delighted to welcome you for a visit to our beautiful site to tell you more about what makes us stand out.
Mrs Kate Walker, Head, Senior School

We are delighted to share what others say about Bruern Abbey.
“A small, caring and aspirational school – parents speak of ‘winning the lottery’ at finally finding one to suit their able boys who need specialist support and a nurturing environment.”
– Good Schools Guide
Read More – Prep School Read More – Senior School
“We don’t use the term transformational lightly, but for the right boy a Bruern Abbey education is just that.”
READ MORE – PREP SCHOOL READ MORE – SENIOR SCHOOL
“Not often I say this but the word ‘glowing’ comes to mind. […] Amazed parents, watch self-esteem and exam results rise.”
For more information what we do here at Bruern Abbey, have a read at our specialisms and enquire today for your son.

GCSE Results 2025
At Bruern, every boy has a special educational need and so the results achieved in our first year reflect not only their talent and determination, but also the transformative value of a supportive and specialist learning environment: small classes, dedicated teachers and a lot of hard work has certainly paid off. Results can never tell the whole story, but some highlights include:
– 83% of boys achieved five passes at GCSE
– 93% achieved a pass (or equivalent) in English Language — with similar success in Maths.
– In English Literature, 30% of grades were awarded at Grade 9, with half at 7+.
– In History, a third of grades reached the top mark of Grade 9.
– In 3D Design, half of grades were awarded at 7+.
Most strikingly, in value-added terms, our boys added nearly three grades to their baseline predictions across their GCSE subjects.
Particular congratulations to Leo S, who scored four 9s and three 8s, to Ben W who scored seven grades at 7+, including two 9s, to Sean H who scored three 9s and Ben P who scored six grades at 7+ – just some among many fantastic individual achievements among so many great stories.

pageCache.text:
Bruern Abbey Prep School is a leading prep school in Oxfordshire and, well known for our specialist approach to education. Our preparatory school offers specialised educational support for students for pupils diagnosed with learning difficulties.
Our school helps pupils build confidence and a love of learning. With small class sizes and expert, experienced trained teachers, every pupil benefits from a personalised approach that helps them flourish with us.
Transitioning to Co-Education
While we began as an all-boys school, as of September 2026, we will be welcoming both boys and girls. This marks the start of our move to a fully co-educational school, with our Senior School in Buckinghamshire set to welcome girls from September 2027. This important development allows us to extend the unique Bruern approach to even more families, while staying true to our founding mission of supporting neurodiverse learners in a nurturing and tailored setting.
A Historical Prep School in Oxfordshire
The prep school is housed in a late Victorian, Italianate house with an excess of 20 acres of grounds including mixed woodland and specimen trees. It is located a few miles from the A34 and the M40, it is just over an hour from London and 15 minutes from Oxford. The school is well-connected by train with two stations in the nearest town of Bicester. The prep school is a 20-minute drive from the Bruern Senior School site.
The school provides the perfect setting for children to thrive and engage in a plethora of opportunities.
An Academic Approach to Primary Education
Academics are of paramount importance at Bruern Prep. Due to pupils’ learning difficulties, they need to be taught in very specific ways to help them reach their full potential. However, we also carefully consider everything else that goes on outside of the classroom.
We take care to ensure that every prospective student at Bruern Abbey is the right fit. This helps us understand the unique challenges they face, as well as their personal strengths. This process is vital to us, as it ensures that we have both the expertise and the facilities available to help a student before enrolment. For more information, check out our admissions journey for more information.
Contact Bruern Abbey Prep School
Ready to find out more? Get in touch with our friendly team today. We are more than happy to talk you through the unique resources we have available to help children with unique learning difficulties. Meanwhile, we would love to learn more about our prospective pupil so that we can tell you how your child might benefit from what we have to offer.

Bruern Abbey Senior School is your leading senior school in Buckinghamshire, offering a highly personalised approach to secondary education for pupils with learning difficulties. Set in a peaceful pastoral environment, our school provides our pupils a supportive and structured setting where every pupil is valued as an individual.
At our secondary school, we recognise that no two pupils learn the same way. Our small class sizes allow us to deliver tailored teaching and specialist special education needs support (SEND), helping each pupil build confidence, independence, and resilience throughout their educational journey.
GCSE Support at Our Senior School
Starting your GCSEs can be both challenging and transformative. Since we first opened our doors in 2022, we have quickly established ourselves as not just a supportive senior school, but also a successful one. This is showcased by our fantastic GCSE results and the prestigious sixth forms and colleges that our students have gone on to join. You can view them here.
What Success Means to Us
Success has no single definition at Bruern Abbey. Instead, we look to our students and the specific challenges they face to create and set achievable goals. Pupils are encouraged to explore their interests, develop their strengths, and grow confidence within a nurturing and purposeful community. We encourage our students to actively participate in setting their own goals and achieving them.
Transition to Co-Education
Our dedication to providing a specialised educational environment is soon to be expanded. Starting in 2027, Bruern Abbey’s senior school will be opening its doors to girls as well as boys.
A Personalised Approach to Secondary Education
At Bruern Abbey’s senior school, we know that pupils do their best when they are understood as individuals and are encouraged to be themselves. We champion difference, recognising that no two pupils learn, think or develop in the same way, and our size means we can take a truly individual approach.
Contact Us and Visit Our Senior School in Buckinghamshire
We hope this introduction gives you a sense of what makes Bruern Abbey Senior School such a distinctive and nurturing place. We would be delighted to welcome you for a visit to our beautiful site to tell you more about what makes us stand out.
At Bruern Abbey School, we recognise the unique challenges that children with executive function difficulties face. Our tailored approach to education is designed to create a supportive and structured environment where each child can excel. We will explore what executive function challenges mean for your son or daughter, how they impact their ability to plan, organise and complete tasks, and how Bruern Abbey School can offer the right support to help them succeed both academically and personally.

We are extremely proud of our first cohort’s GCSE results and their destination schools. These can be viewed here:
Buckinghamshire College
Oxford International College
City College, Oxford
d’Overbroeck’s Sixth Form
City of Oxford College

At Bruern Senior, our team of specialist teachers and school leaders is dedicated to creating a supportive and stimulating learning environment for our boys. With a strong understanding of dyslexia and other learning differences, our staff use their expertise to deliver lessons that are engaging, accessible, and tailored to individual needs.
Every member of our teaching and leadership team plays a crucial role in ensuring that pupils not only achieve academically but also grow in confidence and independence. Through small class sizes, innovative teaching methods, and a nurturing approach, we help each boy reach his full potential.
